regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, non-directional rotation with Memory/HBM & Storage leading (score 2.59, eligible, 75% breadth, not crowded), followed by a tight cluster of AI-infra/semiconductor themes. Momentum rank is a focus lens only (~0 rank-IC), and the one validated edge here is drawdown/shake-out control via the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps true), so any readable edge is about which eligible trends are intact versus broken — not which will outperform.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the challenger AI Infrastructure (score 2.132, breadth 0.875) sustains its momentum and closes the gap to Memory/HBM & Storage; the condition that would retire this watch is a CONFIRMED handoff where AI Infrastructure's score exceeds the leader's for five consecutive sessions (not a prediction — only a flag after it is observable).

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The leader is eligible under the absolute-trend gate with 75% breadth and no crowding flag, so it clears the only validated de-risking leg. The direction is NOT justified by its rank (rank-IC ~0); it is my fallible judgement that a non-crowded, broad-breadth leader is a lower-volatility way to retain thematic exposure than the crowded challengers.
evidence: eligible=true and absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg
breadth=0.75 and crowded=false (no reflexivity/sizing caution active for the leader)
theses.dissent: High capital intensity and cyclicality in memory pricing mean strong breadth today can reverse on a single channel-check on HBM/NAND supply; the theme is historically prone to sharp, order-driven air-pockets that the trend gate intercepts only after damage.

falsifier.text: SMH (proxy for Memory/HBM/Storage) falls below its own 10-day low and stays there for two consecutive sessions

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is eligible and carries the cleanest trend-health in the book: hurst_tag=trend, breadth=1.0, durability_bar=0.81. It is crowded (z=1.91), which is only a size-down caution, never a fade. Being trend-eligible with full breadth is the condition the validated gate cares about.
evidence: crowded=true treated only as a cap/size-down caution per guardrails
theses.dissent: The crowding flag (z=1.91) signals the trade is well-owned, and on any broad software risk-off the unwind in a fully-breadth trend can be fast and indiscriminate even if the absolute-trend gate eventually steps in.

falsifier.text: CIBR closes below its own 21-day moving average for three consecutive sessions

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is ineligible (eligible=false) with hurst_tag=mean-revert and breadth=0.125, meaning it fails the only validated risk-control leg of the detector. The lean is to avoid deploying thematic exposure into a non-eligible mean-reverting theme, not a call that it falls.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting, low-breadth themes can occasionally rip higher on a sharp commodity move; avoiding it forfeits optionality if silver spikes, but the detector's edge is controlling drawdown, not catching that spike.

falsifier.text: SIL posts a >10% cumulative gain over any rolling 5-day window while remaining non-eligible

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
